test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

I had taken a loan from the bank in my mother’s name.

options.text: A bank has been taken by me from the loan in my mother’s name.
A loan had been taken by me from the bank in my mother’s name.
A loan will be taken by me from the bank in my mother’s name.
A loan was taken by me from the bank in my mother’s name.

solution:
The passive voice of the given sentence is __**A loan had been taken by me from the bank in my mother’s name.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Past Perfect Tense__

 
• **The past perfect** refers to a time earlier than before now. It is used to make it clear that one event happened before another in the past.
